title: Strata expert residency, CPU/PCIe balance and bounded tuning
summary: Tune one measured bottleneck while retaining resolved settings, cache state, memory budgets, quality gates and failed trials.

zh-CN.title: Strata 专家驻留、CPU/PCIe 平衡与受控调优
zh-CN.summary: 围绕实测瓶颈调优，保留生效配置、缓存状态、内存预算、质量门槛和失败记录。

conditions: Start from an already working engine, model artifacts and target hardware.
Freeze source/build, model/tokenizer, topology, arrival pattern, output lengths and cache state.

recommendations: Measure CPU task time, transfers, expert misses and window cost before changing workers, PCIe share, cache capacity, prefill or speculation.
Separate cold startup, prompt processing and steady decode; repeat paired trials and retain regressions and invalid candidates.
validation_plan: Check resolved slot/group counts, memory headroom and actual active options rather than requested flags alone.
Validate held-out quality, TTFT, concurrency and long-context memory in addition to decode throughput.
limitations: The native calibration routine performs real generation and engine restarts; its decode heuristic is not a quality or service gate.
Elastic VRAM and batch/MTP interactions are restricted by the actual model/backend path.
This indexed abstract links to the complete bilingual skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
Accelerator execution, real-model quality and service performance remain unverified for this import. Qualify each target revision, model, backend and workload separately.
